label: rem:observable-subcategory-remark
title: Observability, complement and components of the observable subcategory
html:
Observability. One requires a non-degenerate Frobenius pairing to define degree-0 measurements. When A_0|_{\mathcal{S}} = 0, the pairing degenerates on the lowest floor of the brane tower and no degree-0 observable is well-defined. The subcategory \mathrm{Bun}^{\circ} defines the regime where the full observational apparatus functions.

Complement. The complement \mathrm{Bun}(\mathbb{P}(V)) \setminus \mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}(\mathbb{P}(V)) consists of configurations with A_0 = 0. These are the jet horizons and big bang states.

Connected components. The connected components \pi_0(\mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}) are the aeons. Each aeon is a maximal connected full subcategory of \mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}. It encompasses all light cones accessible without crossing a jet horizon.
